Established organisations near the chosen city that help people in need. You give directly to them, on their own website.

A non-profit working for and with people in social or economic hardship, to improve their living conditions and help them take part in society. In Lausanne it runs the Épiceries Caritas and the regional food centre.
A Lausanne association, active since 2020, that runs a free grocery shop at La Bourdonnette for more than 350 people a week. Food is given out without conditions, mostly by volunteers.
Free parcels of basic food for people in need. The organisation depends entirely on the solidarity and generosity of the public.

A Lausanne association, active since 2018, that fights food waste: it harvests unused fruit and vegetables, turns them into preserves in workshops and sells them to fund its work, combining ecology and social inclusion.

A homelessness charity that provides housing, support and advice for people who sleep rough, and works to end rough sleeping.
A charity for young people facing homelessness. It provides a safe place to stay, support and help towards education and work.
A registered charity that supports hundreds of youth clubs and community groups across London, so young people have safe places to learn, play and grow.
A registered youth charity that helps 11 to 30 year olds into education, training and work through free courses, mentoring and start-up support.
A registered charity that provides healthy breakfasts in schools, so hunger is not a barrier to learning for children.
A registered charity that rescues good surplus food and gives it for free to charities, schools and community groups across London, for people facing food poverty.
Registered non-profits only: apolitical, with a focus on homelessness, youth, education and inclusion. No religious groups, businesses, alumni groups or personal benefit.
